# Ghoulvolution - Body Armour Radiation Stats

- Duchess Flame![Writer: Duchess Flame]()
- Mar 19, 2025
- 7 min read

Updated: Apr 5, 2025

![](https://static.wixstatic.com/media/586626_5295964ee8494bb6873928768e2d6d14~mv2.jpg)

Image Credit:

This guide will help Ghoul players figure out the best armor for their build. If you don’t want to get entirely new armor, it also covers which perk cards and ranks you’ll need to balance out your Rad Resistance.

The Ghoul perk card **Breathe It In** can lower your Rad Resistance if you’d rather not switch armor, while **Rad Specialist** increases Rad intake—especially when wearing a matching set.

For more information on these Ghoul perk cards, check out my Ghoul Perk Card Guide __here__.

These tables only show matching armor sets, including their level and class as seen at the Armor Workbench.

Arm pieces and leg pieces are grouped together, so the stats include both arms and both legs.

To keep things simple, this guide only covers armor at levels 40, 45, and 50.

When modding your armor, keep an eye on your stats—some mods add Rad Resistance. Also, double-check your underarmor mods since all modded underarmor provide Rad Resistance, except for Raider Underarmor.

![](https://static.wixstatic.com/media/586626_db5f88a861964acf8c4ab157c56046df~mv2.jpg)

Downloadable copies can be found __here__.

Hey there, I'm Kat, also known as Duchess!

I'm an Aussie data miner who creates guides for farming, events, and food buffs in Fallout 76.

I firmly believe that knowledge should be accessible to everyone, so my guides will always be free. However, maintaining a website and using photo and video editing software can be costly.

If you find my guides useful, here are a few ways you can support me:

- Share My Guides: Help your fellow vault dwellers by sharing my guides.

- __Follow Me on Social Media:__ Keep up with my latest updates by following me on social media.

- __One-Time Donation:__ Buy me a coffee.

- __Monthly Contribution:__ Become a regular supporter by subscribing to my Ko-fi page.

Every bit of support helps cover the costs of creating these guides and maybe even gets me a cup of coffee or three ;)

Thanks for your support!
